goal: Add a regression test proving Pi extension discovery loads exactly the two factory files (imm-canary-enroll.ts and imm-canary-work.ts) and never auto-discovers helper modules (pi-canary-child.ts, pi-canary-invocations.ts, pi-canary-verification.ts, runtime-stub.ts) or any other file in .pi-extension/ as an extension.

acceptance.assertion: A new test file tests/pi-canary-discovery-regression.test.ts loads the real Pi DefaultResourceLoader (in-memory settings, packages pointing at the repo root), asserts loader.getExtensions() returns exactly two extensions whose resolved paths end with imm-canary-enroll.ts and imm-canary-work.ts, and asserts no discovered extension path contains the four helper module names.

The regression test fails when the explicit entry manifest is removed: the test must mutate a temporary copy of the .pi-extension package manifest (delete plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/package.json in a scratch worktree copy) and prove discovery then reports helper modules as extensions, demonstrating the manifest is load-bearing.
